decisions.reason: Locates the fg-only half-filled branches, explains the persisted 48;2 background channel painting the transparent half, prescribes \x1b[49m per half-filled cell, notes the row-end RESET cannot fix in-row leaks, and ties it to edge symptom columns.

Explains the renderer's trailing-space trim plus pipeline whitespace stripping and overwrite semantics for surplus columns; prescribes ESC[K after RESET (non-strippable) plus full-width/overwrite contract, keeping SGR controlled.

Identifies the hand-copied tail2 mismatch with 23 differing cells, marks the renderer innocent (data drift), explains the per-excerpt regression covered a different frame, and mandates all-frame sha256 digests against source art as a CI gate.

Uses the CI evidence: never-unmounted channel-ui probe hosts and the self-rearming referenced setTimeout chain; prescribes .unref() on the planner timer, explains TTY keeps the interactive product alive, and rejects unmount-only fixes for these hosts.
Consolidated checklist (SGR completeness, erase contract, digest gate, timer lifecycle) plus a pre-default-on audit of hosts/handles, data gates and an exit-within-N-seconds liveness watchdog.

caps.reason: Final advice mandates background reset, escape-based erase, source-backed digest gates and unref; no contradicting affirmative conclusions.
